race.comment: Open race but the Evans yard has a great hand with three runners. ONE WHIM (4) is going better than the recent form looks. Placed two back at Murray Bridge then was 10th in town but not beaten far. Well placed here and looks hard to run down. Stablemate WHOOPS A DAISY (8) was fourth and narrowly beaten two back then fifth and beaten less than two lengths in town latest. Well placed and drawn to go close. MANDITO'S MAN (6) was well in the market on debut over 1000m at Murray Bridge in a Class1 and wound up strongly to place. Better for it and can feature again. DAMPEN (1) has been racing in town lately and will find this much easier. Expected to improve sharply. Another Evans runner
